title: Adding a terminal command package: cochange across manifest, README, story, and pinned assets commit
answers: How do I add a new command to the PostHog terminal?
Where are on-demand terminal packages like doom, sl, figlet defined?
body:
Adding an on-demand terminal command touches several places together:
- frontend/src/scenes/terminal/terminal-packages.json: a new entry under packages with name, version, file (archives/<name>-<ver>-linux-i386.tar.gz), sha256, size, archiveSize, dependencies, and commands (command -> /opt/posthog-packages/<name>-<ver>/bin/<cmd>).
- The same file's baseUrl is pinned to a PostHog/terminal-assets commit SHA (not a branch). It must be bumped to the commit that publishes the new archives, which must already be on terminal-assets main.
- frontend/src/scenes/terminal/posthogFilesystem.ts: the mounted README text must list the new commands and their exit controls.
- frontend/src/scenes/terminal/TerminalScene.stories.tsx: optionally add a live story (see LiveDoom/LiveClassics).
Packages download on first use, so nothing is added to boot download.
applies: frontend/src/scenes/terminal package manifest and README when adding or updating commands

Packages download on first use; archives must be on terminal-assets main before manifest references them. Applies to frontend terminal package manifest when adding or updating on-demand commands.
